privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
This policy explains what personal information we collect, why, who helps us process it, how long we keep it, and the rights you have. We collect only what we need to sell and deliver tea — nothing more.

Who we are

{{site.bizName}}{{#if site.bizAddress}}, {{site.bizAddress}}{{/if}}{{#if site.bizCompanyNo}} (company no. {{site.bizCompanyNo}}){{/if}} is the data controller for personal information collected through this website. You can reach us by {{{site.bizContact}}}.

What we collect

WhenWhatWhy (lawful basis)
You place an order (with or without an account)Name, email, delivery and billing address, items, gift message, promo codeTo fulfil the order — contract. Order records are also kept for tax — legal obligation.
You create an accountName, email, a one-way hashed password (we can never read it), saved addressesTo let you sign in, reorder and see your history — contract.
You opt in to bag remindersThe contents of your bag while signed inTo send at most two reminders if you leave tea behind — consent, withdrawable at any time.
You join the newsletterEmail addressOccasional news from the mountain — consent.
You ask to hear when a tea is back in stockEmail address and the teaTo tell you once it returns — consent.
You leave a review or request a refundYour rating, words and reasonTo publish verified reviews and handle refunds — contract / legitimate interests.
SecurityYour IP address, briefly, when you sign in or submit formsTo block password-guessing and spam — legitimate interests. Deleted within 24 hours.

Site analytics. We use Vercel Web Analytics to count page views and see which pages are popular. It sets no cookies and stores nothing on your device; it does not record your IP address or identify you, and it cannot follow you across other websites. We strip anything after the “?” in page addresses before they are counted, and our back office is never tracked. Lawful basis: legitimate interests in understanding how the shop is used.

We do not use advertising trackers or social-media pixels, we do not profile you, we make no automated decisions about you, and we never sell or rent your data.

Who processes it for us

ProviderPurpose
VercelWebsite hosting, and anonymous cookieless page-view analytics
NeonDatabase for accounts and orders
ResendSending order, password-reset and reminder emails
ZohoOur email inbox, for messages you send us
StripeCard payments, when enabled — your card details go directly to Stripe and never touch our servers
Photon (komoot)Address suggestions: the text you type in the street-address field is sent to find matching addresses
postcodes.ioUK postcode suggestions: the postcode you type is sent to look it up

Some of these providers are based in, or use servers in, the United States or the EU. Where your data leaves the UK, it is protected by appropriate safeguards such as UK adequacy regulations, the UK Extension to the EU–US Data Privacy Framework, or the UK International Data Transfer Addendum. Our fonts are hosted on our own site, so browsing does not send your details to Google.

How long we keep it

  • Orders — six years, as UK tax law requires; then deleted.
  • Accounts — until you delete your account (you can do this yourself, instantly, from your account page).
  • Saved bags — deleted 60 days after you last changed them, or as soon as you check out.
  • Newsletter and back-in-stock requests — until you unsubscribe, or 12 months for stock requests.
  • Security logs — 24 hours.

Your rights

Under UK data protection law you can ask to access, correct, delete or restrict your data, object to how we use it, take a copy of it, and withdraw any consent at any time. Every marketing or reminder email has a one-click unsubscribe link.

To get a copy of your data, use Download my data on your account page. To delete your data: if you have an account, use Delete my account on your account page. Without an account, use our data request form. We respond within one month.

If you are unhappy with how we handle your data, please tell us first — but you also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk or on 0303 123 1113.

Children

This website is not directed at children. You must be 18 or over to create an account or place an order, and we do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18. If you believe a child has given us their details, contact us and we will delete them.

Cookies

We use only essential cookies and browser storage — see our Cookie Policy.

Changes

If we change this policy we will update the date at the top of this page, and tell account holders by email about any significant change.

terms.title: Terms of Sale
terms.body:
These terms apply when you buy from us. They are short, fair, and written to be read. They do not affect your legal rights as a consumer.

Who we are

{{site.bizName}}{{#if site.bizAddress}}, {{site.bizAddress}}{{/if}}{{#if site.bizCompanyNo}} (company no. {{site.bizCompanyNo}}){{/if}} is the data controller for personal information collected through this website. You can reach us by {{{site.bizContact}}}.

{{#if site.bizVatNo}}

VAT registration number: {{site.bizVatNo}}.

{{/if}}

Buying from us

You must be 18 or over to place an order or create an account. You can check out as a guest or with an account — the terms are the same either way.

All prices are in pounds sterling and include VAT where applicable. The price you see at checkout is the price you pay: UK delivery is complimentary and there are no hidden fees. If you are ordering for delivery outside the UK, contact us first — we will agree any delivery cost with you before anything is charged.

Your order is accepted when we email you a confirmation. Until card payment is live, orders may be recorded as reservations and a payment link will follow by email. If we cannot fulfil an order — a harvest sells out, say — we will tell you promptly and refund anything you have paid in full.

Cancellations, returns and refunds

See our Refund Policy and Delivery & Returns, which form part of these terms.

Promo codes

One code per order. Codes have no cash value, may be limited in number or time, and may be withdrawn — but never after you have used them on an accepted order.

Reviews

Only customers who bought the tea can review it, and only from their own account after the order. We publish reviews in full whether good or bad, we never pay for, edit or write reviews ourselves, and we only remove a review if it is unlawful, abusive or unrelated to the product.

The product

Tea is a natural, seasonal product, so leaf and liquor vary a little from batch to batch within the character described. Product photographs are representative of what you receive.

Our responsibility to you

We are responsible for loss or damage you suffer that is a foreseeable result of us breaking these terms or failing to use reasonable care. Nothing here limits our liability where the law does not allow it, including for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud, or your statutory rights under the Consumer Rights Act 2015.

Credits & licences

The Mt. Peak name and logo belong to {{site.bizName}}. Our typefaces, Cormorant Garamond and Jost, are used under the SIL Open Font License.

Disputes and law

If something goes wrong, please talk to us first — we will try to put it right. These terms are governed by the law of the part of the United Kingdom where you live, and you can bring proceedings in your local courts.

refunds.title: Refund Policy
refunds.body:
We want every cup to be right. Here is exactly how cancellations, returns and refunds work — including the rights the law gives you, which nothing here takes away.

Changed your mind (14-day cancellation)

Under the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013 you can cancel your order within 14 days of receiving it, without giving a reason. Tell us within that time, then send the tea back within a further 14 days.

Because tea is a food, this right applies to unopened caddies and gift boxes with their seals intact. Sealed food that has been opened cannot be returned for hygiene reasons — the law allows this exception.

Return postage for a change of mind is paid by you. We refund the price of the tea, plus the standard delivery cost (which is complimentary in the UK anyway).

Faulty, damaged or wrong items

Under the Consumer Rights Act 2015, goods must be as described, of satisfactory quality and fit for purpose. If yours are not, you are entitled to a full refund within 30 days of delivery, or a replacement — your choice. After 30 days you are still entitled to a repair, replacement or, in some cases, a refund. We pay all return costs for faulty or incorrect items.

Please send us a photo and your order number as soon as you notice a problem — it helps us put it right quickly.

How to ask for a refund

  • With an account: open the order on your account page and choose Request a refund.
  • Without an account: contact us by {{{site.bizContact}}} with your order number.

You can also cancel an order yourself from your account page any time before it is dispatched, at no cost.

When you'll get your money

We refund to your original payment method within 14 days of receiving the returned tea (or evidence you have sent it back), or within 14 days of agreeing a refund where no return is needed. We never charge a fee to process a refund.

See also: Delivery & Returns · Terms of Sale.

delivery-returns.title: Delivery & Returns
delivery-returns.body:
Delivery

UK delivery is complimentary on every order. Orders are dispatched within 2 working days and typically arrive within 3–5 working days of dispatch. You will receive an email when your order ships, and you can follow it at any time on our order tracking page using your order number and email address.

We currently ship within the United Kingdom. For international orders, write to us first — small-batch tea deserves a plan, not an apology.

Returns

The full details of cancellations and refunds are in our Refund Policy. In short:

Under the Consumer Contracts Regulations you may cancel your order within 14 days of receiving it, without giving a reason. Because tea is a foodstuff, we can only accept returns of unopened caddies and gift boxes with their seals intact.

To start a return, reply to your order confirmation email quoting your order number. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 14 days of us receiving the return. Return postage is your responsibility unless the item arrived damaged or incorrect — in which case we make it right, at our cost, without drama.

Damaged or incorrect orders

If anything arrives less than perfect, email us within 48 hours with a photograph and your order number. We will replace or refund it — your choice.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.body:
A cookie is a small file a website stores in your browser. We use as few as possible — only what the site needs to work. Because they are strictly necessary, UK law does not require your consent for them, but we still want you to know exactly what they are.

What we store

NameTypePurposeLasts
mp_sessionCookie · essentialKeeps you signed in to your account. Secure and HttpOnly — scripts cannot read it.7 days, or until you sign out
mp_adminCookie · essentialKeeps our own staff signed in to the shop back office. Never set for customers.12 hours
mtpeak_cart_v2Browser storage · essentialRemembers what is in your bag as you move between pages.Until you check out or clear it
mtpeak_noticeBrowser storage · essentialRemembers that you have seen our cookie notice, so it doesn't keep appearing.12 months

What we don't use

No advertising or retargeting cookies, no social-media pixels, and no third-party cookies of any kind. We count page views with Vercel Web Analytics, which is cookieless — it stores nothing on your device and does not identify you (see the Privacy Policy). Our fonts are hosted on our own site. When you use address suggestions at checkout, the text you type is sent to our address providers (see the Privacy Policy), but they set no cookies.

Controlling cookies

You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. If you block the essential ones, signing in and your bag will stop working, but you can still browse.
